summary: Ground site on Duncan Hill near Entiat: 1923 cabin, L-4 cab built 1935, cab removed or destroyed in 1967; trails open to hikers.

facts.status_note: Cab removed or destroyed in 1967; sources differ on which. Willhite notes a photo captioned built up lookout platform.

access.note: Reached by Forest Service roads and two maintained trails; no closure is mentioned in these sources.

visit.trail_note: Two well-maintained trails, 6 miles one way with 3,000 ft gain; lower trailhead about 34 miles up the Entiat River Road, then 6 miles on FR-5608 (Willhite).

events.note: A cabin was placed on Duncan Hill; the 1935 L-4 cab replaced it.
Firelookout.com lists H. Johnson as known lookout personnel in 1933.
Panoramic images taken from the roof, 17 feet above ground; Washington Lookouts dates the panorama photos to September 6, 1934.
L-4 cab built on the southerly summit.
Registry says the cab was removed; firelookout.com and Willhite say it was destroyed.
Willhite says a fire in 2015 damaged the area.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: All three sources give 1967 as the year the cab ended. The registry says removed; firelookout.com and Willhite say destroyed. The story reports both words.

notes_for_editor: Brief elevation 2383.2 m matches the registry's 2,383 m. Brief coordinates match the registry. Brief record says status gone, which the sources support. Access is set to public on the basis of the trail and forest road description; no closure is stated. The 2015 fire is recorded as affecting the area; the sources do not say whether it reached the summit site. The photo caption built up lookout platform is the only evidence of remains and is undated.
